transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As you know, the ERG's current chair is stepping down after this program cycle, and I have the authority to approve the group's next leadership charter and participation practices. Before I can sign off on a new plan, the charter approval process requires a consultation with the outgoing chair and deputy chair. I'd like to use this time to start that conversation and hear your thoughts on what the next leadership structure should look like, especially considering we have members who participate remotely in our monthly live sessions.
